Alex: Quick check — change-window embargo starts in 30m. Final go/no-go: can we confirm smoke, canary, rollback owners, and pin list? :eyes:
Deploy Bot: Scheduled freeze will enter 30 minutes from now for change-window 2026-06-07T15:00Z — merge protection enabled. See /deploy logs.
Jamie: Smoke tests green on staging 10m ago. Canary queue primed (3 nodes). I can own rollback if needed.
Maria: Release notes updated and feature flags toggled for the slice. Added rollback steps to ops doc: https://redwood.infra/ops/rollback
SRE Oncall: I'll monitor infra and latency. Set alert thresholds: p95 > 350ms and error-rate > 0.8% -> page.
Alex: OK, pin runtime to v2.4.1-rc3 and model to rwd-13b-q4_mex. No automatic rollout beyond canary.
Jamie: Rollback command (manual hot rollback):
```
rbctl rollback --deploy change-window-20260607 --to-tag v2.4.0
```
Alex: If rollback is invoked, product must sign off before unfreezing. @Product-Ops please ack.
Deploy Bot: Change-window freeze active — merges blocked. Canary traffic at 20% traffic. :white_check_mark:
Product-Ops: Ack'd. Standing by for signoff. :thumbsup:
Maria: Post-launch checklist attached to the doc. If all green, we lift freeze at +2h after launch and start incremental roll to 100%.
Jamie: Noted. I'll stay by for 1hr after rollout for hotfixes.
SRE Oncall: I'll run continuous smoke and post brief every 15m.
Alex: Thanks team. Keep updates short here only.
